projectState.summary: Track A1 is approved and merged to main. The durable Claude review artifact from claude/codex-a1-candidate-store-code-review was cherry-picked, and the candidate-store shell is ready as the foundation for Track A2. A1 adds a bounded Candidate contract, SQLite schema v3 candidates table, server/client write/query/score/retain/purge/cap APIs, candidate.created/scored/retained/purged audit events, db smoke coverage, and middleware smoke coverage. It is inspect-only: no audio, model, generator loop, or playback path consumes candidates. Next: Track A2 pure fitness aggregation, keeping it deterministic, bounded, documented, and inspect-only.
